proposals.evidence: Turner’s section 3 *kṣaṭ/*kṣvaṭ gives Khowar c̣hoi, Bengali chay, Kumaoni chai, Western Pahari chɔ, Gujarati cha and Marathi sahā/sā. The selected forms belong to these named regional affricate or western sahā families, including ordinary source c/ts spelling, deaspiration and contracted h/v variants. They are kept separate from the northwestern ṣuvaṭ branch; added classifier material is excluded.
